coordinateSystem: Unmodified DAMIT co-rotating Cartesian frame; positive Z is the north pole; positive X defines the meridian; east-positive longitude; arbitrary display phase
source: DAMIT model 1843, version 2017-09-21: ecliptic J2000 lambda 207 deg, beta -6 deg, period 6.081435 h; equatorial J2000 conversion uses obliquity 23.439291111 deg. The original model page and DAMIT frame documentation are pinned. The display does not claim the source epoch phase.
